cases.name: A stay that the land hosts.
cases.line: A small hotel or retreat of twelve rooms or fewer, sitting inside a food forest and water-harvested landscape. Guests pay for the place. The place feeds itself.

cases.name: A school that grows what it teaches.
cases.line: A learning centre woven into a working farm. Children learn from the soil and the seasons. Tuition and harvest both contribute to the running of the place.

cases.name: A retreat in a food forest.
cases.line: Yoga, ayurveda, or healing programmes set in a regenerating landscape. Retreat fees, kitchen produce, and seasonal programmes all earning from the same acres.
